answer: Assembling that for 175 aliases means 175 times 3 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each atlas escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the tundra ledger records every share and the vertex audit publishes the split. A bond must be split across 3 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
